title: C. elegans Vulva Formation: Induction, Lateral Signaling and Cell Fate

coverage_matrix.official_syllabus: Unit 5.C, both CSIR syllabus PDFs; MP SET 2024 third-party-hosted official-looking copy
coverage_matrix.roadmap: P3.p–P8.p, competence, anchor cell, LIN-3/LET-23/Ras/MAPK, LIN-12/DSL and lateral communication, 3°–3°–2°–1°–2°–3°, lineage and morphogenesis, ablation and pathway mutants, Vul/Muv, quantitative and experimental predictions

dimensions.E: ATP phosphorylation, GTP hydrolysis, diffusion and binding assumptions
dimensions.G: decay and binding derivations, numerical datasets
dimensions.H: ablation, controls, rescue, reporters, hypothetical data
dimensions.I: cell to epithelial organ and function
dimensions.N: competence, cell signaling and next lens node
dimensions.O: 52 explained problems including data and mutations

coverage_matrix.not_applicable: No measured in-vivo diffusion or energetic constants, clinical/agricultural prescriptions, or specialist research protocols; no artificial calculations.

review_pass_1.checks: Cross-checked roadmap and both official CSIR PDF pages and MP SET mirror, indexed primary/review excerpts; corrected lineage polarity, primary terminal types and anchor-cell temporal roles. Toy models explicitly hypothetical; calculations independently recomputed.

review_pass_2.type: separate internal teaching/exam and technical review
review_pass_2.checks: Compared 14,125 teaching words with exemplar 5.A.08 (14,170 whitespace-count words); inspected progression, answer rationales and figures; corrected receptor geometry, sender/receiver diagram and source cross-links, table responsiveness; verified saved HTML.

deductions: Some primary/review full text blocked; indexed abstracts and excerpts used.
A few conceptual questions intentionally straightforward, explanations compact.
Toy quantitative models not empirical fitted data; experimental examples limited to syllabus level.
No independent human peer review; static checks rather than interactive browser rendering.

validation.deployment: pending until Pages workflow and live checks
